Sasha K: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference/pulls/458
Quick repro:
```
# run eval harness
python tools/eval.py --model=llama3-xxlq --prompts=promptsets/spanish_v2.json --seed=42 --batch-size=8
```
Observed: token-level shift on multi-turn samples (suffix truncation in a few cases).

Kevin: saw a similar token shift on a quant run last week. Try `--no-kv-cache` to rule out KV-cache interplay.

ml-bot: Eval summary uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/1768012345/spanish_v2/summary.json — rouge_l: 0.62 -> 0.58, BLEU stable.

Phil: I'll queue PR review now. ETA ~3pm PT. @Sasha K can you add a short unit test for the tokenizer edge-case?

Sasha K: adding the test now, will push in ~20m. thanks :thumbsup:

expected: "Resumen:"
